themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Marine Le Pen's eligibility ruling and Nigel Farage's resignation to trigger a by-election dominate far-right news, reflecting shared struggles with legal constraints and political legitimacy across France and the UK. Both leaders frame their actions as battles against establishment forces, resonating with their transnational base.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen's reduced ineligibility sentence allows her to run for president in 2027, sparking debates on judicial leniency and political opportunism.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage resigns as MP to contest a by-election amid financial scrutiny, framing it as a 'people vs establishment' fight.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Abascal criticizes Trump's attacks on Meloni, signaling a strategic shift in European far-right alliances.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's diplomatic tensions with Trump highlight far-right divisions over NATO and national sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces EU scrutiny over its party status, mirroring Le Pen's legal battles with EU institutions.

themes.title: Milei’s ‘shutdown’ policy sparks global right-wing emulation
themes.blurb: Argentina’s Javier Milei proposes a U.S.-style government ‘shutdown’ to cap public spending, inspiring parallel debates in Europe and the U.S. about fiscal austerity and state overreach. The policy’s cross-national appeal underscores a shared right-wing agenda of shrinking the state.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei announces a U.S.-style 'shutdown' law to freeze public spending when budgets are exhausted, alongside Central Bank reforms.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump’s administration previously implemented shutdowns, providing a model for Milei’s proposal.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox’s economic policies in Andalusia echo Milei’s austerity measures, focusing on reducing public spending.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega’s Tovaglieri proposes biofuels over electric cars, aligning with Milei’s deregulatory approach to economic policy.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates ahead of NATO summit
themes.blurb: Tensions between Donald Trump and Giorgia Meloni over NATO commitments and Iran policy dominate coverage in Italy, the U.S., and Spain. The feud highlights fractures within the far-right over transatlantic alliances and national sovereignty, with Vox and other European parties taking sides.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump criticizes Meloni for not supporting U.S. actions in Iran, threatening NATO troop withdrawals.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni maintains 'cordial' relations with Trump despite his public insults, downplaying the feud to preserve diplomatic ties.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Abascal defends Meloni against Trump’s attacks, signaling a rift in the far-right’s transatlantic alliance.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage’s resignation overshadows the NATO summit, but his anti-establishment rhetoric aligns with Trump’s criticisms of European allies.

themes.title: Public media crackdowns fuel far-right backlash
themes.blurb: Hungary’s suspension of state TV news and Poland’s media reforms spark protests and accusations of authoritarianism from far-right and conservative factions. The crackdowns reflect a broader pattern of right-wing governments targeting independent media, with cross-national solidarity emerging among opposition groups.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Poland’s government faces criticism for media reforms, with PiS accusing opposition of undermining press freedom.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox demands transparency in public media, aligning with Fidesz’s accusations of left-wing bias.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD criticizes German public media for alleged bias, echoing Hungarian and Polish far-right narratives.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Spain’s Vox and Italy’s Lega propose measures to restrict immigration, including scrapping language classes for Moroccan students and prioritizing ‘national citizens’ in crime reporting. These policies reflect a shared far-right agenda of cultural protectionism and border control across Europe.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox proposes scrapping Moroccan language classes in Andalusia and publishing criminals' origins in crime reports.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega’s Tovaglieri advocates for biofuels over electric cars, aligning with Vox’s anti-globalist economic policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen’s anti-immigration stance resonates with Vox’s proposals, reinforcing a shared far-right agenda.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD’s anti-immigration policies in Germany mirror Vox’s proposals, focusing on cultural assimilation and border security.
